assessments.reasoning: AGPL [28959,29400) identifies both the permitted acts and the terms retained by each part. Its single-work and GPLv3 qualifications account for the counterexamples. The source-inclusion obligation appears in the preceding paragraph.

limitations: Whether particular components form one work requires facts about those components. The permission names GPL version 3 specifically.
reasoning: AGPLv3 §13 paragraph 2 permits linking or combining an AGPLv3-covered work with a GPLv3-licensed work into one work and conveying the result. AGPLv3 continues to govern its covered part and GPLv3 governs the part brought in under GPLv3.
